result_summary.title: Audit log gaps and data residency mismatch in Analytics Dashboard (US-West)
result_summary.description: We have detected gaps in the audit logs within the Analytics Dashboard in the US-West production environment. Additionally, there is a mismatch with the data residency flags; some data appears to be routed incorrectly despite our configuration settings. This is affecting 41 users who rely on accurate compliance reporting. We need this investigated to ensure we are meeting our data residency obligations.
